data.body:
## RCA — confirmed by observing the message fire (fast path: single site, single mechanism)

**Observed, not read.** Dropped a throwaway test that writes a top-level file into a
disposable worktree's REPO_ROOT and ran pytest against it. The backstop fired verbatim:

    REPO ISOLATION FAILURE: the test run left new changes in the checkout (a test wrote
    into the working tree instead of tmp_path). Offending entries from `git status
    --porcelain`:
      ?? BLUEJAY_PROBE.txt

Run exit status 1, so the escalation branch (`session.exitstatus = TESTS_FAILED`) also
executed — detection works and must stay exactly as it is.

**Mechanism.** `tests/conftest.py::pytest_sessionfinish` builds that string from
`leaked = sorted(after - _PORCELAIN_AT_START)` — the set difference of two
`git status --porcelain` snapshots taken at `pytest_sessionstart` and session end. A set
difference over a wall-clock window records that entries *appeared*; it carries no writer
identity. Any other process sharing the checkout (a concurrent commit, rebase, branch
switch, build, or an editor save) produces an identical diff entry, so
"a test wrote into the working tree instead of tmp_path" is a claim the evidence cannot
support. "Offending" compounds it by presuming wrongdoing before the cause is known.

**Legitimacy: defect.** Cited authority, three sources: `docs/local-dev-env.md` already
documents this guard family misfiring on external writes; and the same false attribution
was ruled a defect twice already in closed bugs on the two sibling messages
(`746c-185a-0e48-4b83` for `leak_failure_message`, `hot-guessable-ungulate` for
`head_move_failure_message`). Prior closed Fixed: tickets for the same behaviour class
make this one a defect too.

**Agreement with the siblings on attributability.** No divergence. Two `git status
--porcelain` samples carry no more attribution signal than the two `git rev-parse HEAD`
samples that `hot-guessable-ungulate` examined. Every ownership proxy (mtime, birthtime,
name shape, path) is satisfied equally by a legitimate external write. No detection
signal is being invented here; the message is being made to state its own limit and
condition on what only the reader can know.

**Defect origin: `gusto-pixel-signal` (`4c79-3873-807d-4a0d`).** Introducing commit
`d8b077451be9a5e22b472cec27e7b51b5dc54b50`, which added the session backstop and this
exact string, and carries `(4c79-3873)` in its subject.
`git blame -w -C -M -L 726,738 -- tests/conftest.py` attributes every line of the message
block to it, with no carrier commit in between. Date test: the wrong claim was authored
in that commit rather than broken by a later one, so this is a `plan_defect`, not a
regression — the same class and the same origin ticket that sibling
`hot-guessable-ungulate` recorded.

**Scope.** Wording only, plus a behaviour-preserving extraction of the text into
`tests/_isolation.py` so it can be pinned on observable content, mirroring both siblings.
Detection, the entry list, and the `session.exitstatus` escalation are unchanged and
pinned by a test.
